goal: The landing strategy exposes a landability predicate that reports whether a finished run produced a committed, non-empty change against its base, which non-git strategies answer affirmatively by default.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00061-FEATURE-landable-change-gate.md -- criteria #2, #3, #6 and decisions D-1, D-3; the predicate-seam layer

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_strategy.py -- the SubmitStrategy structural protocol; add the optional landability predicate as a new hook with a default that reports landable

packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- GitWorktreeSubmitter; lift the existing porcelain (git status --porcelain, ~line 518) and commit-count (_commit_count, git rev-list --count base..branch, ~line 534/685) checks into a non-mutating inspection the predicate calls
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/ and packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/ -- add predicate unit tests here; keep existing suites green
constraints: The predicate is read-only: it inspects the worktree/branch and returns a verdict; it must NOT mutate, merge, park, rebase, or clean up. The existing submit() landing logic is unchanged.
A non-git strategy (no diff notion) inherits a default predicate that reports landable, so non-code task classes are unaffected.
Keep flywheel-core pure and the orchestrator git-free: the predicate's git inspection lives only in the worktree strategy module (D-1).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT wire the predicate into the orchestrator run loop yet -- that is landable-change-gate.
Do NOT change submit()'s park/merge/rebase behavior.
Do not modify existing test assertions; add new tests only.
edge_cases: Committed, non-empty diff vs base -> predicate reports landable.
Clean tree but zero commits beyond base (empty diff) -> not landable.
Dirty tree (uncommitted modifications or untracked files) -> not landable.
A SubmitStrategy with no git/diff notion -> default predicate reports landable (no-op), proving non-code classes opt out (criterion #3).
